sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $3::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $4::timestamptz AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $5::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((e.properties -> $5::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((e.properties -> $5::text))::float8 END END >= $6::float8), false) GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 >= $7::float8) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND c.person_id = p.id AND c.channel = $9::text AND c.topic_id = $8::uuid AND c.dimensions_key = '' AND c.status = $10::text) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM segment_members sm WHERE sm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND sm.person_id = p.id AND sm.segment_id = $11::uuid AND sm.exited_at IS NULL)) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $12::text)) = 'string' THEN (p.traits ->> $12::text) = ANY($13::text[]) END), false)))
